newsitem.title: UK: Benchmark seeks 119 mln stg in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Benchmark seeks 119 mln stg in rights issue.

text.p: Central London property investment and development company Benchmark Group plc on Thursday said it aims to raise about 119 million stg though a one for one rights issue at 200 pence a share to help finance the purchase of a number of properties.

Benchmark said it had entered into conditional agreements to acquire a portfolio of 11 properties from Friends Provident for an aggregate cash consideration of 82 million stg, and to buy Wool House in southwest London from Chelsfield for an initial consideration of 38.25 million stg in cash.
It said it was issuing 60,279,771 new ordinary shares.

In addition, Benchmark declared a maiden interim dividend of 3 pence per share to cover the financial year ending June 30. This dividend is being declared in place of a final dividend following the year end and will not be paid on the New Ordinary Shares.
